title: socialize
tagline: Socialize is a platform for you to meet like minded folks and explore the unexplored!
description: This project aims at providing a custom events list to folks and to connect them with like minded folks to explore, grab a beer or collaborate on their next project. We ensure your identity is safeguarded and display events based on your interests. Users can upvote/downvote the events and also follow the hosts of the events. One can register as an host or as an attender of an event.
how_its_made: We are using idemix for authentication and store the hash on IPFS. We use lens protocol to post, comment and follow users on the platform. The users signup as either hosts or as users. Based on the role, they can create events (specific to hosts) and non-hosts can just view and upvote, downvote and/follow the hosts.
